*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: project.yml
+name: SimControl
+options:
+  bundleIdPrefix: local.simcontrol
+targets:
+  SimControlUITests:
+    type: bundle.ui-testing
+    platform: iOS
+    deploymentTarget: "16.0"
+    settings:
+      PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: local.simcontrol.uitests
+      GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES
+      CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED: NO
+    sources:
+      - UITests
*** Add File: UITests/ContextMenuTests.swift
+import XCTest
+
+final class ContextMenuTests: XCTestCase {
+    func testOpenBookClubContextMenu() {
+        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
+        app.activate()
+
+        let room = app.staticTexts["Book Club"].firstMatch
+        XCTAssertTrue(room.waitForExistence(timeout: 10))
+        room.press(forDuration: 1.2)
+    }
+}
*** End Patch
